title: Conditions/List (501-1000)
html:
The list of all conditions in the game is split into the following pages so as to limit the size of each page:

  • Conditions/List (1-500)
  • Conditions/List (501-1000)
  • Conditions/List (1001-1500)
Condition Effects
False Life
  • Gain  7 temporary hit points plus 5 additional for each spell slot level above the first.
Faltering Will
  •  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks until Long Rest.
Fangs of the Fire Snake
  • Affected entity's fists are flickering with flame. Its melee attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠⁠Fire damage.
Favoured Weapon
  • This weapon has +1 bonus to damage and attack rolls.
Fear Aura
  • The affected creature can  Frighten nearby beasts and humanoids with its fey presence.
Fearful
  • Has  Disadvantage on Ability Checks and  Attack Rolls.
  • It must run from the source of its fear and cannot take any additional actions.
  • Targets can make a  Saving Throw to shake off this effect if they end their turn out of sight from their source of fear.
Feather Fall
  • Rate of falling is slowed, granting Immunity to Falling damage.
Feeble
  • Deal only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength. At the end of each turn, the affected creature can make a Constitution  Saving Throw to end this condition.
Feigning Death
  • Has sunk into a magical coma deep enough to imitate death
  • Resistant to all damage except ⁠Psychic damage, and Disease and Poison no longer have any effect
  • Removed when Helped
Festering Frenzy
  • This gnoll will become  Frenzied at the start of his next turn.
Festering Spores
  • While  Symbiotic Entity is active you can spread  Bibberbang Spores,  Timmask Spores, and  Haste Spores.
Fetcher's Favour
  • Equipped with  Mol's tricks of the trade, affected creatures can cast  Rays of Fire, reduce all Fire damage by 5 and gain an additional 1d4 to Charisma Checks and Saving Throws.
Fetid Aura
  • All nearby creatures fall victim to the ooze's Fetid Fumes and 1d6⁠⁠Acid per turn.
Fetid Fumes
  • The fumes emanating from the Fetid Ooze eat away at the affected entity, so long as it stays within 2 m (7 ft).
  • 1d6⁠⁠Acid at the start of each round.
Feverish
  • Increasingly feverish.  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Strength.
  • When the duration ends, make a  DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw. Failing will inflict the condition  Filth Fever.
Feywild Sparks
  • While  Tides of Chaos is active, the affected entity will always trigger its  Wild Magic Surge when casting spells.
Fiendish Obeisance
  • Affected entity must obey the commands of the fiend directly controlling it.
Fiendish Obeisance: Kneel
  • Affected entity has been compelled to kneel by a fiend. It cannot move or take actions, bonus actions, or reactions, and has  Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity  Saving Throws.
  • Attacks against it have  Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the entity. The entity must spend half its movement speed to stand up.
Fiendish Resilience: Acid
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Acid damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Bludgeoning
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Bludgeoning damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Cold
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Cold damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Fire
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Fire damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Force
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Force damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Lightning
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Lightning damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Necrotic
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Necrotic damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Piercing
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Piercing damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Poison
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Poison damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Psychic
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Psychic damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Radiant
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Radiant damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Slashing
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Slashing damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Thunder
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Thunder damage.
Fiendish Vice
  • Affected entity can call on diabolic arcana to cast  Thaumaturgy,  Hellish Rebuke,  Burning Hands, and  Flame Blade once each until the next Long Rest.
Fiery Brew
  • Affected entity deals an additional 2d6⁠⁠Fire damage while infused with Thisobald's current brew.
Filth Fever
  • Crushed by fever.  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls, and  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Strength.
  • When the duration ends, make a  DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw. Failing will re-inflict the Filth Fever condition.
  • Duration: 25 turns
Fire Infusion
  • The affected entity deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Fire the next time it deals damage with a weapon.
Fire Resistance
  • You gain Resistance to ⁠Fire damage, and can no longer  Burn.
Fire Resistance Aura
  • The fantastical powers of this hallucinatory imp give all nearby creatures Resistance to ⁠Fire damage.
Fire Shield: Chill
  • Wreathed in ice-cold flames.
  • Sheds light in a 3 m (10 ft) radius.
  • Has Resistance to ⁠Fire damage.
  • Deals 2d8⁠⁠Cold damage to anyone who hits with a melee attack.
Fire Shield: Warm
  • Wreathed in scorching flames.
  • Sheds light in a 3 m (10 ft) radius.
  • Has Resistance to ⁠Cold damage.
  • Deals 2d8⁠⁠Fire damage to anyone who hits with a melee attack.
Firewine Belly
  • Drunk on Firewine. Has  Disadvantage on Charisma and Dexterity Checks
  • If the drunk entity is killed with ⁠Fire, a  Firewine Explosion occurs.
Flame-Feeble
  • Affected entity is Vulnerable to Fire damage.
Flaming Aura
  • Creature is standing within 1.5 m (5 ft) of a flaming sphere and will take 2d6⁠⁠Fire at the end of its turn. On a successful save, it will still take half damage.
Flaming Sphere
  • Enemies and objects within 1.5 m (5 ft) of the sphere at end of their turn take 2d6⁠⁠Fire damage. On a successful save, it still takes half damage.
Fleeting Protection
  • If the affected entity is attacked with ⁠Radiant damage, Raphael's protection reflects twice that amount as ⁠Fire damage and this condition ends.
Flesh Rot
  • Flesh is decaying.
  •  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws using Charisma.
  • Vulnerable to all damage.
  •  DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw to remove condition when the duration ends, otherwise it is reapplied.
Flesh to Stone: Restrained Stage 1
  • Affected entity cannot move as its body begins to petrify over the course of 3 turns.
  •  Attack Rolls against it have  Advantage, while the entity's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving Throws have  Disadvantage.
Flesh to Stone: Restrained Stage 2
  • Affected entity cannot move as its body progresses toward petrification.
  •  Attack Rolls against it have  Advantage, while the entity's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving Throws have  Disadvantage.
Flesh to Stone: Restrained Stage 3
  • Affected entity cannot move as its body enters the final bone-stiffening stages of petrification.
  •  Attack Rolls against it have  Advantage, while the entity's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving Throws have  Disadvantage.
Flight
  • Fly up to target position, up to 18 m (60 ft) each turn using your Movement Speed.
Flying Strike
  • Affected entity has flown this turn. Its next melee weapon attack deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Psychic.
Foolish Little Pup
  • Shouldn't have done that, petal. Frightened.
For Vlaakith!
  • A githyanki raider marked you in Vlaakith's name to gain  Advantage on attack rolls against you.
Force Conduit
  • ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage against the affected entity is reduced by 1 per turn remaining.
  • If the entity takes damage while it has 5 or more turns remaining, it deals 1d4⁠⁠ForceDRS damage in a 6 m (20 ft) radius.
  • Maximum Duration: 7 turns.
Force Resistance
  • Resistant to ⁠Force damage.
Force Steadfast
  • Affected entity can't be moved against its will.
Forced Manoeuvre
  • Movement speed increased by 4.5 m (15 ft) and doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.
Form of Artifice
  • Your constructed form grants you  Advantage on  Attack Rolls and resistance to ⁠Lightning damage.
Form of Dread
  • The Ch'r'ai has 15 Temporary Hit Points and can't be  Frightened. Each time she attacks a foe, that foe can become  Frightened for 1 turn.
Formless Slaughter
  • This creature has a +1 bonus to Attack and Damage rolls while disguised or shapeshifted.
Fox's Cunning
  • Has  Advantage on Intelligence Checks.
Fractured Psyche
  • Your  Armour Class is reduced by 5 and you have a -5 penalty to  Saving Throws.
Fractured Psyche
  •  Armour Class and  Saving Throws are reduced by 1.
Freedom of Movement
  • The affected creature's Movement Speed cannot be reduced by  Difficult Terrain, spells or magical effects.
  • The affected creature cannot be  Paralyzed or  Restrained.
Frenzied
  • Deal an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.
  • Also has Resistance to physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Frenzied Fury
  • Overwhelmed with rage, the gnoll can attack three times per turn.
Frenzied Spores
  • Glut has increased hit points and Strength. It has access to more spore spells.
Frenzied Strain
  • Using  Frenzied Strike adds a stack of Frenzied Strain. The barbarian takes a -1 penalty on Attack Rolls for every stack.
  • All stacks are removed when  Frenzy ends.
Friends
  • Has  Advantage on  Charisma Checks directed at the target creature.

In higher difficulty modes, the target might accuse you of enchanting them.

Frightened
  • The affected creature cannot move. Frightened creatures also have  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Attack Rolls.
Frostbite
  • When taking ⁠Cold damage, takes an additional 1⁠⁠Cold damage per turn of Frostbite remaining.
Frostbitten
  • Affected entity takes 1d4⁠⁠Cold damage when attacking with a weapon.
Frozen
  • Affected entity is utterly enamelled in ice and is  Incapacitated. If it is dealt Bludgeoning, Thunder, or Force damage, the ice shatters, ending the condition.
  • Gains Vulnerability to ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Thunder, and ⁠Force damage.
  • Gains Resistance to ⁠Fire damage.
  • Gains immunity to  Burning and  Encrusted with Frost.
Fugitive
  • Recently escaped from prison. Guards will arrest this prisoner on sight.
Fungal Resistance
  • The hag has a +5 bonus to Saving Throws for each nearby Pearlspore Bell.
Fungal Resurrection
  • The hag will be resurrected by nearby Pearlspore Bells at the start of their next turn.
Galerian Revelry
  • Compelled to shuffle and dance.
  • Affected entity can't move or take actions.  Attack Rolls against it have  Advantage, while its Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving Throws have  Disadvantage.
Galvanic Currents
  • Blue lightning flits across the weapon's surface. Deals an additional 1d6⁠⁠Lightning.
Gaping Wounds
  • Successful attacks against the creature deal an additional 2⁠⁠Piercing damage.
  • Removed by healing.
Garrotted
  • Affected entity is being strangled by a garrotte. It is Silenced and takes 3d6⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage per turn.
  • Both the entity and the garrotter can't move until the condition ends.
  • If the entity and the garrotter are forcibly moved more than 5 m (17 ft) apart, this condition ends.
Garrotted: Restrained
  • Cannot move.  Attack Rolls against the affected entity have  Advantage, while the entity's  Attack Rolls and  Dexterity Saving Throws have  Disadvantage
Garrotting
  • Strangling a creature with a garrotte.
  • Moving more than 5 m (17 ft) away from the creature will break the garrotte.
Gaseous Form
  • Transformed into a cloud of mist.
  • Resistant to all non-magical damage.
  • Has  Advantage on Constitution, Dexterity, and Strength  Saving Throws.
  • Becomes Tiny in size.
  • Cannot attack, cast spells, or speak.
  • The target's Strength and Dexterity scores are set to 10 while in this form.
  • Immune to  Bleeding.
Gaseous Reflux
  • Physical attacks have added gas to Thisobald's special brew, letting him use  Roaring Belch.
Gathering Drumbeat
  • A goblin has sounded these war drums, calling reinforcements to battle.
  • Will draw nearby goblins into combat. If used in the Goblin Camp, will turn the entire camp hostile as well. All  Temporarily Hostile enemies become permanently hostile.
Ghastly Fume

The affected entity's foul stench creates a pungent cloud that  Nauseates all creatures around it.

Giant Form
  • Affected entity's size is increased. Its weapon attacks deal an additional 1d6 damage. It gains  27 temporary hit points, and has  Advantage on Strength  Ability Checks and  Saving Throws.
Giant's Rage
  •  Raging and increased in size. Deals an additional 2 damage (increased to 3 at barbarian level 9) with melee and improvised weapons, unarmed strikes, and 4 damage (increased to 6 at barbarian level 9) while throwing objects.
  • Also has resistance to ⁠Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength Checks and  Saving Throws.
  • Size is increased by one category.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on Spells.
Gigantic Endurance
  • Gained  27 temporary hit points.
Githyanki Providence
  • A mote of githyanki psionics allows the affected entity to cast  Misty Step,  Enhance Leap, and  Blur once each until its next Long Rest.
Githyanki War Magic
  • Can make a weapon attack using a bonus action.
Githzerai Mind Barrier

Having assimilated a splinter of githzerai knowledge, mental barriers have been erected in the affected entity's mind. It has  Advantage on Intelligence Saving Throws.

Glimpse of Freedom
  • Escaping certain death, the character is motivated to move 4.5 m (15 ft) quicker.
Gloomweave
  • Has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls. Attacking or casting spells that are not Shadowslip ends this condition.
Glutted Catacombs
  • This area is filled with the bones of the dead. The spell  Animate Dead: Skeleton does not require a skeleton to raise the dead in this area.
Gnawing Horde
  • Ravenous Ghouls that fight alongside you.
Gnomish Ingenuity
  • Affected entity is Proficient in Sleight of Hand Checks and can cast  Knock until it takes a Long Rest.
Goaded
  • Must attack the goading creature, if possible.
  •  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against targets other than the spellcaster.
God of Ambition
  • Mere mortals whisper petitions to the newly divine Gale Dekarios as The Once-Wizard, High Aspirant, The Lord of Zeal - but none have yet been granted an audience with the God of Ambition. Until tonight, that is.
Gossamer Tomb
  • This creature is entombed in  Infested spider silk, and cannot move or take actions. Unless the silk is removed with ⁠Acid or ⁠Fire damage, it will explode, dealing 10d8⁠⁠Poison[See: Bugs] to the entombed creature.
Grappled
  • Affected entity is incapacitated and cannot be damaged while held within the grapple.  Help it to free it!
Grappled
  • At the start of each turn, the target makes a  Strength Saving Throw to attempt to free themselves. On a failed save, they take 2d6⁠⁠Psychic.
Grappled
  • Affected entity is incapacitated and cannot be damaged while held within the grapple.  Help it to free it!
Grappling
  • Affected entity has Grappled another creature. Cannot move while Grappling. Interrupted by receiving damage.
Grasp Essence
  • When you hit a creature with an unarmed attack, you can regain 10⁠⁠Hit Points or choose to gain  Advantage on Attack Rolls or Saving Throws before the end of your next turn.
Grasping Arrow: Entangled
  • Affected entity will take 2d6⁠⁠Slashing damage when it moves, and its movement speed is reduced by 3 m (10 ft).
Gravely Wounded
  • This person cannot be healed or saved.
Great Weapon Master: Bonus Attack
  • Can make a melee attack as a  Bonus Action.
Greater Arcane Hunger
  • The Netherese Orb in Gale's body is weakening him. He has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and all  Saving Throws.
Greater Elixir of Arcane Cultivation
  • Has an additional  Level 2 Spell Slot. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.
Greater Invisibility
  • Entity has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls. Attack Rolls against it have  Disadvantage
  • When interacting with items, casting spells, or attacking, the entity needs to succeed on a Stealth Check to maintain Invisibility. The Check becomes harder with each successful attempt.
Greater Toughness
  • This material is extremely strong. Only a hit that deals at least 50 damage can damage it.
Green Bed Regeneration
  • When starting your turn on  Plant Growth Surface or  Vine Surface regain 1d4⁠⁠Hit Points.
Grieving
  • The affected creature has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls but  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks while processing the loss of something dear to it.
Gripped by Kereska's Flame
  • Affected entity has resistance to ⁠Fire damage.
  • Its fire spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus.
  • When it deals spell damage, it gains 2 turns of Heat.
  • While attuned to Kereska's flame, it can cast  Fireball at 3rd level and  Wall of Fire at 5th level once per short rest.
Grotesque Distention
  • Bloated beyond hope. Will explode at the slightest touch.
  • Touching an entity affected with this condition will cause a blast of 8d6⁠⁠Poison damage in a 3 m (10 ft) radius, form a Poison Cloud of the same size, and utterly destroy the entity.
Guardian Wraiths
  • Affected entity is Immune to all damage. When this effect ends, the entity will be healed for 6d8⁠⁠Hit Points, unless it is ended by  Greater Restoration or  Remove Curse.
Guidance
  • Gains a +1d4 bonus to  Ability Checks.
Guided Strike: Active
  • You have a +10 bonus to your next  Attack Roll.
Guiding Bolt
  • The next  Attack Roll made against this creature has  Advantage.
Haemorrhaged
  • The target takes 1d6⁠⁠Piercing damage at end of turn.
Hag Pregnancy
  • The hag has eaten the child to transform her into a newborn hag. Killing the hag will lead to the child's death.
Hag's Pawn
  • Ethel has taken control. Condition lasts until mask is removed or spellcaster is dead.
Hag's Trickery
  • Is this Ethel - or an illusion?
Half-Orcish Fury
  • The next time the affected entity is  Downed, it instead drops to 1 hit point thanks to the relentless will roiling in its veins.
Halfling Luck
  • The luck of the smallfolk grants the affected entity  Advantage on Skill Checks until its next Long Rest.
Hallucinating
  • Creature is hallucinating. It has  Disadvantage on Ability Checks, wanders around uncontrollably, and can't take  Actions or reactions.
Hamstrung
  • Movement Speed reduced by 50%.
  • Removed by healing.
Hand of the Absolute
  • Adds 1d4⁠⁠Psychic damage to your attacks. You get one boon per enemy caught in the radius of your Psychic Plague.
Hands Off, Petal
  • Ethel disapproves, dearie.
  •  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks and Saves.
  • Take 3d4⁠⁠Psychic damage when condition is received.
Hands Off, Petal
  • Ethel disapproves, dearie.
  •  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks and Saves.
  • Take 4d4⁠⁠Psychic damage when condition is received.
Hands Off, Petal
  • Ethel disapproves, dearie.
  •  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks and Saves.
  • Take 2d4⁠⁠Psychic damage when condition is received.
Happy
  • Astarion's vampiric hunger has been temporarily sated. +1 to all Attack Rolls, Saving Throws, and most Ability Checks.
Harm
  • Affected entity's maximum Hit Points have been reduced by the damage inflicted by the Harm spell
  • This condition is a Disease
Harmonised
  • Affected entity's melee weapon attacks deal additional damage equal to its Charisma Modifier (min.1).
Harrowed
  • The affected entity is psychically oppressed by a powerful ghost. It has  Disadvantage on Charisma and Wisdom  Saving Throws.
Haste Spores
  • Affected entity has a +2 bonus to  Armour Class,  Advantage on Dexterity  Saving Throws, its  Movement Speed increases by 9 m (30 ft),[See: Bugs] and it can take one additional  Action per turn.
Hastened
  • Creature has a +2 bonus to  Armour Class,  Advantage on Dexterity  Saving Throws, its  Movement Speed increases by 9 m (30 ft),[See: Bugs] and it can take one additional  Action per turn.
  • When the condition ends, the creature becomes  Lethargic.
Haunted Approach
  • This creature's Movement speed and jump distance is halved while within 3 m (10 ft) of a Cursed Skull
Haunting Aura
  • Nearby creatures are afflicted with  Phantasmal Force.
Healer: Healed
  • The creature can't regain hit points from this feat again until it finishes a long rest.
Healing Incense
  • Affected entity regains 1d4⁠⁠Hit Points at the start of the spellcaster's turn, as long as they remain within 10 m (33 ft) of them.
Healing Incense Aura
  • Applies Healing Incense to affected entity and allies within 10 m (33 ft), regaining 1d4⁠⁠Hit Points per turn.
Healing Pearl
  • At the start of its turn, this mushroom keeping Auntie Ethel alive regains all its hit points unless some effect prevents it from restorative healing.
Healing Radiance
  • Allies within 3m / 10ft will regain Proficiency bonus + Paladin level + Charisma modifier⁠Healing at the start of the Paladin's next turn.
Heart of Stone
  • Gain Resistance to ⁠Poison until next Long Rest.
Heartform Mapped
  • The affected entity's  Violent,  Craven,  Jealous,  Melancholy, Prying,  False, or  Wayward Heart has been mapped and punished by Viconia.
Heartform Terror: Ceremorphosis
  • Overcome with the fear they've turned into an illithid, the affected entity cannot move or take actions.
Heartform Terror: Spider
  • This creature has twisted its form into one of your fears.
Heartform Terror: Wolf
  • This Sharran knows your fears and has twisted its form into one of them.
Heartform Terror: Wolf
  • This Sharran knows your fears and has twisted its form into one of them.
Heat
  • Engulfed by a vengeful fire. Takes 1d4⁠⁠Fire damage each turn, but can use  Heat Convergence.
  • Heat Convergence consumes all remaining turns of Heat to deal extra ⁠Fire damage on their next fire spell or attack.
  • Heat has a maximum Duration: 7 turns.
Heat Convergence
  • The next time the affected entity deals Fire damage, it deals an additional 1 for every turn of  Heat still affecting them.
Heat Metal
  • Heats up a metal weapon or armour on a creature with no save (weapon is automatically prioritized).
  • Metal weapons are dropped if the creature holding it fails their initial  Saving Throw.
  • If the creature is touching the heated metal item, they receive  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
  • Each subsequent turn, if the creature is still touching the metal, the spellcaster can use  Reapply Heat Metal to deal another 2d8⁠⁠Fire damage, forcing the creature to pass a Saving Throw again or drop the item (if it is a metal weapon).
Heat Metal: Disadvantage
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and  Ability Checks until the start of the caster's next Turn.
Heat Metal: Reapply Damage

Creature can reapply the damage dealt by the heated metal.

Heavily Encumbered
  • Carrying far too much weight.
  •  Movement Speed heavily reduced, and you can no longer climb or  Jump. You also have  Disadvantage on  Ability Checks and  Attack Rolls, as well as Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution  Saving Throws.
Heavily Obscured
  • Hiding in a Heavily Obscured area. Will go undetected unless they get too close to another creature.
Hellfire Cambion
  • This cambion's attacks deal Hellfire damage, ignoring Resistance and Immunity to ⁠Fire damage.
Hellfire Curse
  • Hellfire roiling within this creature gives it  Disadvantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution  Saving Throws.
Hellish Sphere
  • Creature is standing within 3 m (10 ft) of a flaming sphere and will take 6d6⁠⁠Fire damage at the end of its turn. On a second save, it will still take half damage.
  • Dexterity save, based on the user's Wisdom Spell Save DC.
Hellish Sphere
  • Enemies and objects within 3 m (10 ft) of the sphere at the end of their turn take 6d6⁠⁠Fire. On a successful save, they still take half damage.
Her Voice: Commanding
  • Affected entity's brain is being tortured at the whim of the Absolute. It receives a -1 penalty to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Abilities and takes 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage at the end of its turn.
Her Voice: the End of All
  • Affected entity's brain is being tortured at the whim of the Absolute. It receives a -4 penalty to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Abilities and takes 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage at the end of its turn.
Her Voice: Transforming
  • Affected entity's brain is being tortured at the whim of the Absolute. It receives a -2 penalty to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Abilities and takes 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage at the end of its turn.
Heroic
  • Affected entity has gained  10 temporary hit points.
Heroism
  • Can't be  Frightened.
  • Receive  5 temporary hit points per turn.
Hexblade's Curse
  • Cursed by a Hexblade warlock. The warlock who cursed this entity adds their proficiency bonus to damage rolls against them. The number they need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking this entity is also reduced by 1.
Hexed Weapon
  • The warlock bound to this weapon is always Proficient with it.
  • The weapon's damage is magical and uses the warlock's Charisma modifier.
  • When the warlock attacks with this weapon, there is a chance that  Hexblade's Curse will be applied to the target.
Hexed: Charisma
  • Creature suffers an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage from the spellcaster.
  • It also has  Disadvantage on Charisma Checks.
Hexed: Constitution
  • Creature suffers an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage from the spellcaster.
  • It also has  Disadvantage on Constitution Checks.
Hexed: Dexterity
  • Creature suffers an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage from the spellcaster.
  • It also has  Disadvantage on Dexterity Checks.
Hexed: Intelligence
  • Creature suffers an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage from the spellcaster.
  • It also has  Disadvantage on Intelligence Checks.
Hexed: Strength
  • Creature suffers an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage from the spellcaster.
  • It also has  Disadvantage on Strength Checks.
Hexed: Wisdom
  • Creature suffers an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage from the spellcaster.
  • It also has  Disadvantage on Wisdom Checks.
Hide in Plain Sight
  • Affected entity is invisible. It has  Advantage on Attack Rolls. It has a +10 bonus to Stealth Checks.
